description: This file contains various query functions for searching and retrieving data related to ERPNext entities such as Employee, Lead, Customer, Supplier, Item, BOM, Project, Delivery Note, Batch, Account, and others. It includes functions decorated with frappe.whitelist for external access, utilizing SQL queries to fetch data based on search terms and filters.

methods.name: employee_query
methods.description: Searches for active employees based on search input and filters.

methods.name: lead_query
methods.description: Searches for non-converted leads based on search input.

methods.name: customer_query
methods.description: Searches for customers based on search input and user default settings.

methods.name: supplier_query
methods.description: Searches for suppliers based on search input and user default settings.

methods.name: tax_account_query
methods.description: Retrieves tax accounts matching search input, considering account type filters.

methods.name: item_query
methods.description: Searches for items with various filters, including description and barcode.

methods.name: bom
methods.description: Searches for Bill of Materials entries based on search input.

methods.name: get_project_name
methods.description: Retrieves project names based on search input and optional customer filter.

methods.name: get_delivery_notes_to_be_billed
methods.description: Fetches delivery notes pending billing based on search input and filters.

methods.name: get_batch_no
methods.description: Retrieves batch numbers filtered by item, warehouse, and expiry date.

methods.name: get_account_list
methods.description: Fetches list of accounts matching search input and filters.

methods.name: get_blanket_orders
methods.description: Retrieves blanket orders filtered by item, type, and company.

methods.name: get_income_account
methods.description: Fetches income accounts based on search input and company filter.

methods.name: get_filtered_dimensions
methods.description: Retrieves dimension filters based on doctype, search input, and filters.

methods.name: get_expense_account
methods.description: Fetches expense accounts based on search input and company filter.

methods.name: warehouse_query
methods.description: Searches warehouses with optional stock quantity info, filtered by item and warehouse filters.

methods.name: get_batch_numbers
methods.description: Retrieves batch IDs filtered by item, expiry date, and other filters.

methods.name: item_manufacturer_query
methods.description: Searches for item manufacturers based on search input and item code filter.

methods.name: get_purchase_receipts
methods.description: Fetches purchase receipts matching search input and item filter.

methods.name: get_purchase_invoices
methods.description: Retrieves purchase invoices based on search input and item filter.

methods.name: get_tax_template
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax templates for an item, considering item group and date filters.

methods.name: get_fields
methods.description: Returns a list of unique fields for a given doctype, including search fields and title field.
